Rationale: Choose the high-value topic relation about/关于 as the core learning unit; approximate about/大约 is a separate meaning and is not merged here.
Choose the elementary role relation as/作为、当作 as one clear learner-facing core; comparison/time/reason conjunction uses can be introduced later through separate constructions.
Choose the elementary directional back concept used productively in movement phrases; the body-part noun back is not merged into this target sense.
Transport and method phrases make the means relation the most productive elementary core of by; other relations are not folded into this learning unit.
Keep the lexical action sense do/做、干 as the base learning unit; auxiliary do and negative/question frames remain grammar/expression presentation.
Use the purpose/beneficiary relation as the learner-facing core of for; duration exchange and other grammatical extensions belong in later examples or phrases.
Keep the foundational possession sense have/有、拥有; auxiliary functions and many have collocations remain separate grammar or lexical-phrase learning units.
Choose the basic interior/location relation as the core learning unit of in; time/state uses are later grammatical extensions rather than reasons to block the base word.
